filter.title: RGB glitch
filter.desc: Splits the channels, offsets red and blue, recombines them with `screen` and slices the result with horizontal band noise.

feOffset.data-tweak-dx: [-30, 30 px] Red shift | Horizontal shift of the red channel
[-30, 30 px] Blue shift | Horizontal shift of the blue channel

feTurbulence.data-tweak-baseFrequency: [0, 0.5] {pair} Slice frequency | Horizontal and vertical; keep the horizontal value at 0 for horizontal bands

feDisplacementMap.data-tweak-scale: [0, 60 px] Slice displacement | How far the slices move
